Each currency is calculated separately with no exchange-rate conversion.
stats.methodRecurring: Recurring costs include only active monthly, quarterly and yearly subscriptions that have started. The monthly figure is the annual budget divided by 12; actual charges follow each billing cycle. Paused, cancelled, trial, expired and not-yet-started records are excluded from the current budget.
stats.methodOneTime: One-time and lifetime purchases are excluded from recurring costs. They total {amount} on record, which doesn't represent the total amount paid.

forecast.noPositive: No non-zero renewals are projected under the current filters.
forecast.noPayments: No usable billing dates under the current filters.
forecast.notesEstimate: As of {asOf} (UTC date), estimated from current prices, statuses and valid billing dates — not actual past spending. Trial, paused, cancelled and expired records produce no forecast, and records without a reliable date are never assigned a guessed charge date.
forecast.notesPayments: The list shows each subscription's next billing date; overdue records keep their original date. This is only an on-page reminder — nothing is charged or notified automatically. Switch currencies to see the others.

fields.name: Service name
fields.amountNote: Recorded in the original currency with no exchange-rate conversion. JPY accepts whole numbers only; other currencies allow up to two decimal places. One-time and lifetime purchases don't count toward recurring costs.
fields.dateNote: Without a date, no charge is assumed; overdue dates are kept as entered. Trials aren't assumed to convert into paid plans.
fields.priceChangeNote: Saving appends a snapshot of the new price; existing price history stays read-only.
fields.iconNote: A managed icon takes precedence over the site favicon; if fetching fails, the default icon is used and saving isn't affected.
